name: Elowen Harlow
source:
Race: Elf

Elowen Harlow owns one half of The Summit with her twin Erevan. She has a personal mission to bring beauty and finery to the world. Some may find her difficult to deal with, but Elowen has learned not to take such criticism to heart.
